Each variant here is a resume/tailors/<id>.json overlay (summary override + skillsOrder + leadBulletGroup only — never invented content) rendered by scripts/render_resume_tex.mjs into resume/variants/<id>.tex. To add a new variant, use the resume-variant skill instead of editing this file by hand.

matching.instructions: For each posting, check the title (and any JD snippet available) for a cloud keyword (aws/amazon web services, azure/microsoft azure, gcp/google cloud) and a role keyword (devops, sre/site reliability/reliability engineer, platform engineer, infrastructure engineer, cloud engineer, forward deployed). Priority order: (1) if the title is explicitly Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or Cloud Engineer, use that dedicated variant regardless of any cloud mentioned — those variants are cloud-agnostic by design; (2) else if both a cloud and a DevOps/SRE-family role are identifiable, use the matching <cloud>-<role> variant; (3) else if only a DevOps/SRE-family role is identifiable (no cloud named — the common case for LinkedIn-discovered postings with no JD detail), use generic-devops or generic-sre; (4) if role itself is unclear (e.g. Forward Deployed Engineer/SRE with ambiguous scope), default to generic-devops and say so explicitly rather than guessing. Never pick a gcp-* variant unless GCP is explicitly named in the posting — do not infer GCP from generic 'cloud' language.
